sources.title: AfriMT5 - Wycord
sources.snippet: AfriMT5 (afri-mt5-base) is an mT5-based machine translation model from the Masakhane community fine-tuned to translate across 16 African languages using multilingual adaptive fine-tuning. It targets news-domain translation for low-resource African languages, several of which were not previously covered by existing benchmarks. It is distributed as open weights on HuggingFace.
